candidates.change_summary: Remove the overflow check requirement so that balance can overflow on addition.
Delete the balance addition so msg.value is not added to balance.
Set unlockTime to _unlockTime unconditionally instead of the max of _unlockTime and block.timestamp.
Set unlockTime to block.timestamp unconditionally instead of the max of _unlockTime and block.timestamp.
Replace 'acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am);' with 'acc.balance -= _am + 1;' to cause balance to decrease by an extra 1 wei beyond the collected amount.
Replace 'acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am);' with 'acc.balance = _am;' to set balance to the collected amount instead of decreasing it.
Replace 'acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am);' with 'acc.balance = 0;' to zero out the balance after any collection.
Delete the line 'acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am);' so the balance is not reduced upon collection.
Replace the call argument in 'msg.sender.call{value: _am}("");' with '{value: 0}' so that no ether is actually transferred, changing the final balance.
